_purpose: lambda = 0, N = 64, under amendment 1, with the ladder packed where the run showed it was needed rather than where a rule guessed. t6b_lam0_n64 spaced its rungs by 1.5/(5.8 N) in 1/g, sized from the latent heat measured at N = 36; but the gap at N = 64 is 9.5 per point, not 5.8, so the product came out near 2.5 and swap acceptance collapsed to 0.26 at the pair around g = 6.75 -- the same place and value as the severed shared-ladder run -- giving 1 to 2 round trips. Here the rungs between g = 7.05 and 6.35 are placed every 0.00125 in 1/g, about three times finer, and the rest of the ladder is as before. This is a sampling-efficiency change, not an analysis change: any valid ladder samples the same distributions, and gate 4 judges whether the sampling was adequate. 33 rungs.
name: t6b_lam0_n64_dense
